name: NieR:Automata The End of YoRHa Edition

achievements.name: Opening Descent
achievements.detail: Finish the opening factory mission and reach the city ruins.

achievements.name: Resistance Camp
achievements.detail: Reach the Resistance camp in the city ruins.

achievements.name: Ending A
achievements.detail: Clear the first campaign as 2B through to its ending.

achievements.name: Ending B
achievements.detail: Clear the second campaign as 9S through to its ending.

achievements.name: Chip Fusion
achievements.detail: Fuse two plug-in chips into one stronger chip.

achievements.name: Amusement Park
achievements.detail: Clear the amusement park and its ruling machine.

achievements.name: Pascal's Village
achievements.detail: Reach the machine village led by Pascal.

achievements.name: Mackerel
achievements.detail: Eat a mackerel and take the joke ending that follows.

achievements.name: Colosseum Trial
achievements.detail: Clear a ranked trial at the Flooded City colosseum.

achievements.name: Ending E
achievements.detail: Reach the last ending after both outcomes of the final choice are recorded on the same save.
